dependent_bootstrap.resampling: Circular blocks of common origin-date vectors; truncate concatenation to original date count
dependent_bootstrap.weighting: Equal contracts within each common date, then equal retained dates
dependent_bootstrap.sign: Primary minus comparator mean FZ0; negative favors primary
dependent_bootstrap.success_rule: All comparator one-sided 95% upper percentile limits below zero at BOTH block lengths
dependent_bootstrap.interpretation: Approximate dependent historical bootstrap; stationarity and sufficiently weak dependence are not established for this single market path. Not distribution-free future-market coverage.
dependent_bootstrap.multiplicity: Strictly conjunctive intersection-union criterion, not post hoc selection among comparisons; all intervals and comparator results retained.

scope: Previously unscored assets on one archived ECB source and already examined calendar periods; correlated asset transfer, not independent temporal replication.
comparison: Negative primary-minus-comparator FZ0 favors primary; neither returns nor percentage improvement.
jensen_interpretation: Pointwise dominance over randomized expert selection with identical weights in expectation; does not imply dominance over the best expert.
regret: Any pathwise optimization-regret diagnostic remains in the producer results and concerns its declared comparator and feedback order; bootstrap intervals are not regret bounds.
